mechanism_narrative: A higher level of the federal funds rate (as of the decision point) is associated with negative S&P 500 20-day returns, reflecting the inverse relationship between interest rates and equity valuations.
failure_condition: Rank IC between FEDFUNDS and 20d returns is >= -0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A monthly unemployment rate exceeding 5.0% signals deteriorating labor market conditions that reduce corporate earnings expectations, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 20-day returns are positive in more than 40% of months when UNRATE > 5.0, or the Rank IC between UNRATE and 20d returns is >= 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous rise in unemployment rate and deceleration in employment growth (PAYEMS growth < 0.1%) signals a deteriorating labor market, which reduces corporate profit expectations and drives negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 20-day returns are positive in more than 40% of months when UNRATE rises and PAYEMS growth is below 0.1%.

mechanism_narrative: During a monetary tightening cycle (defined by FEDFUNDS above 4.5% and rising), the S&P 500 experiences negative forward returns over the next 20 trading days due to reduced liquidity and higher discount rates.
failure_condition: S&P 500 20-day returns are positive in more than 40% of months with FEDFUNDS > 4.5% and rising, or the Rank IC between FEDFUNDS (in tightening regime) and 20d returns is >= 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A monthly housing starts volume exceeding 1.8 million units signals robust consumer demand and economic expansion, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 5-day returns are negative in more than 40% of months when HOUST > 1800, or the Rank IC between HOUST and 5d returns is <= -0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A monthly industrial production index above 115 signals strong manufacturing activity and economic momentum, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 60-day returns are negative in more than 40% of months when INDPRO > 115, or the Rank IC between INDPRO and 60d returns is <= -0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: In a late-cycle expansion regime (defined by housing starts above 1.8 million units), the S&P 500 experiences positive forward returns over the next 20 trading days due to sustained consumer spending and corporate earnings growth.
failure_condition: S&P 500 20-day returns are negative in more than 40% of months with HOUST > 1800 (late-cycle expansion), or the Rank IC between HOUST and 20d returns in these months is <= -0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous rise in the federal funds rate and unemployment rate signals a stagflationary environment, which leads to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 5-day returns are positive in more than 40% of months when both FEDFUNDS and UNRATE are rising, or the Rank IC of the interaction term (FEDFUNDS * UNRATE) with 5d returns is >= 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.
